Blocks all telemetry, analytics, and observability data collection.
Removes the imposed delay when changing VPN servers.
Lists only free server locations in Countries and Search and connects to the one you pick. Works with or without Unlock VPN Plus.
Hides settings that need a paid plan, upgrade banners, the Discover VPN Plus carousel and special offers.
Spoofs the VPN Plus tier for all UI unlocks, while routing connections through free servers for server-side compatibility. Also skips the upgrade onboarding dialog after login.
Enables app features locked behind the subscription paywall.
Stops Facebook from detecting screenshots and screen recordings.
Removes sponsored feed stories, Reels ads, game ads, and banner ads.
Removes FLAG_SECURE so screenshots and screen recordings work everywhere in Facebook.
Makes Facebook believe an ad-free session is active, so the server stops sending sponsored content (including sponsored Stories tray circles).
Removes sponsored posts from profile pages by checking for an advertisement\'s tracking id. Posts without one are left alone.
Stops the story viewer from reporting stories as seen, so the owner does not see you in the viewer list.
Opens the real destination of Facebook\'s l.php redirect links, without fbclid tracking.
Removes sponsored results from Facebook search, identified by the result\'s own advertisement type. Organic results are left untouched.
Broad upstream hooks: ad-break state machine and banner-ad boolean sweep. May break some screens; off by default.
Removes mid-roll ad breaks and the docked sponsored card from videos and live replays.
Filters sponsored InboxAdsItem rows from Messenger inbox lists.
Stops sending your typing status in normal and end-to-end encrypted chats.
Blocks the background services Messenger\'s analytics logger uploads through. Events are still recorded on the device.
Stops sending read receipts in normal and end-to-end encrypted chats. Chats you open may stay unread on this device.
Lets you screenshot protected chat media, including view-once and Quicksnap, and stops the screenshot notice to the other person.
Opens other people\'s stories without adding you to their viewer list. A story opened this way may still show as unseen on your device.
Adds options to hide fullscreen ads, Premium promotions and video ads.
Hides the upgrade tab from the pivot bar.
Enables the option to play audio without video.
Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.
Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.
Removes the sponsored rows Gmail renders between conversations.
Filters promoted ad cards from the Google Discover feed.
Adds an option to disable Shorts from resuming on app startup when Shorts were last being watched.
Adds options to hide general ads, Premium promotions and video ads.
Adds options to enable and configure volume and brightness swipe controls.
Adds an option to disable captions from being automatically enabled.
Adds an option to use a different host for user avatar and channel images and can fix missing images that are blocked in some countries.
Adds options to enable and configure SponsorBlock, which can skip undesired video segments such as sponsored content.
Adds options to disable or force HDR, and to disable VP9 codecs.
Adds options to hide components related to Shorts.
Adds options to display buttons in the video player to copy video links.
Adds an option to always use the original audio track.
Adds options for debugging and exporting Morphe logs to the clipboard.
Removes the tracking query parameters from shared links.
Adds an option to set which page the app opens in instead of the homepage.
Adds options to hide general layout components.
Adds options to customize available playback speeds, set a default playback speed, and show a speed dialog button in the video player.
Adds options to set default video qualities and always use the advanced video quality menu.
Adds options to hide video action buttons in fullscreen and portrait modes.
Removes restrictions on background playback, including playing kids videos in the background.
Adds support to download videos with an external downloader app using the in-app download button or a video player action button.
Adds options to hide and change the bottom navigation bar (such as the Shorts button) and the upper navigation toolbar.
Adds options to replace video thumbnails and titles using the DeArrow API, or replace video thumbnails with image captures from the video.
Hides injected ads, sponsored content, paid partnership, and Reels/Stories ads.
Removes tracking parameters from Instagram links when copying.
Long-press a received instant (quicksnap) in a direct message to save it.
Adds a Download entry when a profile picture is opened, saving the full-resolution image rather than the cropped thumbnail.
Adds a download button to the story viewer. A story with music offers the video and the still photo separately, since the photo has no soundtrack to strip.
Makes unexpired view-once and replayable media permanently accessible.
Prevents story seen notifications from being sent to the uploader.
Allows screenshots in DMs, stories, and reels by removing FLAG_SECURE.
Prevents view-once / view-twice seen and replay notifications from being sent.
Saves each file into a sub-folder named after the account it came from, instead of dropping everything into one folder.
Prevents Instagram from knowing you viewed a live stream by blocking the heartbeat/viewer-count endpoint.
Blocks ghost mode network requests via TigonServiceLayer (screenshot, view once, story seen).
Adds a Copy link entry beside Download in the post and reel menus, which copies the direct CDN URL of the media.
Adds a Download entry to the three-dots menu on a post. Carousels open a sheet to save the current slide or every slide at once.

Keeps direct messages visible after the person who sent them unsends. Blocks Instagram from dropping the message from the conversation and from deleting it locally. Unsending your own messages still works.
Appends the date and time to every saved filename, so saving the same post twice keeps both copies.
Adds a chip to the instant camera that sends a picture from the gallery instead of one taken right then.
Prevents vanish/ephemeral (disappearing) messages from being deleted locally.
Adds a Download entry to the reel overflow menu. Reels whose video and audio arrive as separate streams are merged before saving.
Blocks screenshot notification from being sent to the other party.
Blocks typing indicator from being sent to the other party.
Blocks DM read receipts from being sent, while chats you open are still marked as read on this device.
Blocks ads and analytics network requests for Feed, Reels, Stories, and Explore.
Hides injected ads, sponsored content, and paid partnership posts in Threads feed.
Removes tracking parameters from Threads links when copying.
Blocks ads and analytics network requests.
Adds options to hide ads.
Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.
Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit\'s native guest browsing mode.
Disables SoundCloud\'s analytics.
Disables the OneTrust consent/cookies popup and collapses banner views.
Enables SoundCloud Go+ premium features, offline listening, HQ audio, and disables audio/visual ads.
Stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, Firebase screen reports and the Npth/MonitorCrash crash reporters. The For You feed then no longer learns from what you watch.
Skips the full-screen splash and TopView ads shown when TikTok opens or returns from the background, and stops TikTok downloading them.

Removes sponsored videos from the For You, Following, Friends and profile feeds, mid-roll and profile pager ads, search result ads and the scroll lock of short-drama ads, including ads inserted after the feed was loaded and the cold-start cache.
Also hides creator posts labelled \"Paid partnership\" (branded content), \"Creator earns commission\" and location affiliate posts. Your own posts are kept.
Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.
Also hides videos flagged by TikTok as using a paid promoted sound. May hide some organic creator videos.
Removes the tracking parameters (utm_*, share_*, u_code, _r, _t, ...) from TikTok links before they are shared or copied.
Saves videos and photos without the TikTok watermark.

Skips browsing puzzle dialogs and reports them as closed. Account verification (SMS, e-mail, password, identity) and login flows are left alone. The action that triggered the puzzle will usually fail instead.
Forces TikTok\'s web-based Google sign-in. Only needed when the APK was re-signed (LSPatch or a repackaged build), where Play Services rejects the native flow.

Stops TikTok from reporting what you look at: story views, profile visits, the typing indicator and which videos of people you follow you watched (their view history). Your online status is unchanged.
Opens website links from profiles and story link stickers in your phone\'s browser instead of TikTok\'s in-app browser.
Hides the TikTok Shop product cards (price, voucher, \"Not interested\" and \"Claim\" buttons) inserted into the For You feed. Independent of Remove feed ads, which only removes sponsored videos.
Removes TikTok\'s forced login screen so the feed stays usable while signed out.
Shows and enables \"Save video\" (and save photo / GIF / Live Photo) even when the creator turned downloads off, and keeps the sound in saved videos.

Takes FLAG_SECURE off every TikTok window so screenshots and screen recordings work on protected screens too (paid LIVE, payment and verification pages, ...), and lifts the Circle to Search block on the feed.
Unlocks \"Routes\", \"Matched Runs\" and \"Segment Efforts\".
Get translate option for all posts.
Removes promoted posts, trends and Google ads.
Adds an option to show poll results without voting.
Removes premium upsells.
Hides the \"new posts\" banner shown at the top of the timeline.
Hides recommendation items such as \"Who to follow\" and \"Today\'s news\" in timeline, search, and replies.
Gets rid of t.co short urls by showing the expanded URL instead.
Disables Haze blur in the Compose UI of the new X app, while preserving the configured fallback tint and scrim effects. Has no effect on the older X UI.
Unlocks media downloads and offline video saving in the X app.
Stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, Firebase screen reports and the Npth/MonitorCrash crash reporters. The For You feed then no longer learns from what you watch.
Skips the full-screen splash and TopView ads shown when TikTok opens or returns from the background, and stops TikTok downloading them.

Removes sponsored videos from the For You, Following, Friends and profile feeds, mid-roll and profile pager ads, search result ads and the scroll lock of short-drama ads, including ads inserted after the feed was loaded and the cold-start cache.

Forces TikTok\'s web-based Google sign-in. Only needed when the APK was re-signed (LSPatch or a repackaged build), where Play Services rejects the native flow.

Opens website links from profiles and story link stickers in your phone\'s browser instead of TikTok\'s in-app browser.
Hides the TikTok Shop product cards (price, voucher, \"Not interested\" and \"Claim\" buttons) inserted into the For You feed. Independent of Remove feed ads, which only removes sponsored videos.
Removes TikTok\'s forced login screen so the feed stays usable while signed out.
Shows and enables \"Save video\" (and save photo / GIF / Live Photo) even when the creator turned downloads off, and keeps the sound in saved videos.

Takes FLAG_SECURE off every TikTok window so screenshots and screen recordings work on protected screens too (paid LIVE, payment and verification pages, ...), and lifts the Circle to Search block on the feed.
Keeps messages visible in the chat when the sender recalls them.
Hides the Zinstant ad row in the Messages (Tin nhắn) tab and skips loading its content.
Turns off Google/Firebase Analytics (measurement) inside Zalo and blocks its connection to the Google Play services measurement service. Push notifications are unaffected.
Keeps Adtima\'s offline (pre-cached) ad window closed and stops its active-view / impression tracking hits.
Also blocks pre-roll, mid-roll and audio ad requests. May delay or stall playback if Zalo waits for an ad result — turn this off first if video stops starting.
Stops Firebase Crashlytics from collecting and uploading Zalo crash reports, logs, custom keys and your user ID. Zalo itself is unaffected.
Stops Zalo from recording events, screens, sessions and views in its analytics database, so there is nothing for it to upload.

Turns off Zalo\'s Story and Community ad slots at their server config flags, so sponsored items are never inserted (no blank gaps, no impressions). Promotions sent as Official Account messages are not affected.
Hides sponsored items in the story viewer. Verify the story tray still advances before relying on this.

Sends photos in Zalo\'s existing Original quality by default, including photos shared in from other apps, and skips the client-side Z Cloud entitlement check. Photos taken with the in-app Zalo camera stay HD. Server upload limits, account restrictions and video quality are unchanged.
Gives Zalo and its ad/analytics SDKs an all-zero advertising ID with ad tracking limited, instead of your real Google advertising ID.

Keeps large chat files that are still stored on the device usable after Zalo marks them expired, instead of showing the Z Cloud / expired screen. It does not restore missing files or bypass server download limits.
Always drops AdMob, Google Ad Manager and IMA from Adtima\'s mediation list, whatever the server config says.
Blocks Adtima impression/click reporting and the Zalo ads tracking receiver.
Hides ad containers, native ad layouts and outstream ads in Zalo Video.
Stops sending the \"Đang nhập\" (typing) indicator in individual and group chats. Blocks the typing packet at the socket transport, with the message repository wrapper as a fallback.
Keeps the \"Photos – backed up on Google Drive\" option available even after your old backup was deleted. Zalo otherwise only offers it to accounts whose existing backup already used Drive.

Records Zalo one-to-one voice/video call audio to Recordings/Zalo Call Recordings as M4A. Runs the native ZRTC recorder. Default off. Recording calls may require the consent of all parties where you live — check local law before enabling.
Stops the bundled Adtima SDK from fetching ad creatives (api.adtimaserver.vn/mobad/*) for native, bundle, banner, interstitial and rewarded placements.

Watches friends\' stories without adding you to their viewer list. The \"seen story\" packets are dropped before they reach the server; stories are still marked as watched on this device. Reactions and replies are still sent.
Tells the bundled Adtima SDK that ad tracking is limited and skips its Google advertising-ID lookup. Complements the Adtima request blocks.

Hides your read receipts (\"Đã xem\") while still sending delivered status, so you keep receiving other people\'s receipts. Blocks the outbound seen ack at the socket transport (covers direct chats and the group/batch SendSeenManager) with the message repository as a fallback.
Prevents sponsored feed items from loading their zinstant bundle and reporting impressions. Disable this one first if the feed misbehaves.
Drops sponsored items from the Nhật ký feed at the JSON parse layer, before any view is created. Experimental — turn this off first if posts go missing from your feed.
Collapses sponsored zinstant items in the Nhật ký feed to zero height.
